author: Karl Rock
description:
Sick New World is back in Las Vegas after a rough few years and last year’s cancellation… but is it actually fixed, and should you go?

I flew all the way from Delhi, India to attend the Sick New World Festival 2026 and find out if the biggest complaints from previous years have finally been solved. People complained about sound issues, scheduling chaos, overcrowding, and poor organisation. With tickets reaching up to $700 and around 80,000 people attending, this is one of the most expensive and talked about metal and rock festivals in the world.

In this vlog, I take you inside the full Sick New World (SNW) experience at the Las Vegas Festival Grounds. You will see what it is really like from entry and security to VIP vs GA, crowd sizes, food prices, water access, and overall organization. I also break down whether the lineup actually justifies the price and what it feels like trying to watch the biggest bands in massive crowds.

The lineup features huge artists like System of a Down
title: Sick New World 2026: Fixed or Still Broken?
